services.desc: Please click to take a brief survey about our Navy Recreational Lodging Program at the RV Park. Your input matters to us! Overlooking the St. Johns River, the Manatee Cove RV Park offers excellent rates on its forty-two sites, 39 full sites (sewer, water, and electric) and three partial hookup sites (water and electric). Facilities include a bathhouse with showers, restrooms and a free laundry room. At this Navy Recreational Lodging destination, Wi-Fi is available free of charge. Reservations can be made six months in advance. Check-in with an MWR representative at the Recreational Lodging Office located in Bldg. 622, at the corner of Birmingham Avenue and Jason Street.
